messages.subject: [Sciviews-help] Komodo-Edit / sciviews-k / svUnit trouble
messages.body_plain:
First of all, let me thank you for the wonderful sciviews-k/sciviews-r! I just 
discovered it and am delighted.

However, I do have a little trouble getting the integration with svUnit working.

I installed Komodo-Edit 5.2.4, sciviews-k 0.9.16, and sciviews-k-unit 0.7.2 
(also the R-reference and the experimental source-tree). The R-packages I 
installed first from CRAN, and then from r-forge (thinking that may solve my 
trouble).

When I try to load the svUnit package (by sending library (svUnit) via 
Ctrl-Enter), I only get a message

The socket server in unavailable
Trying to write data though the SciViews-K socket server that is not started!

I went to the Sciviews-K Toolbox -> Commands -> Server.
R Socket server info tells me that R is on port 8888.

Socket client info says:
SciViews socket client:
Local socket server on port 7052 (stopped)

I tried Socket client start, which leads to a "Sciviews-K server started" in the 
status bar at the bottom, but the output of  Socket client info stays "stopped" 
(nor can I load the svUnit package).

I tried to use older versions of sciviews-k (15-slim and 12), but the problem 
was the same.

What am I missing? I think I must have overseen something really basic on the 
sciviews-k internet page, but somehow I didn't get it.
Also, I tried to switch on the Socket client debug, but I couldn't find where 
its output goes.

If I load library ("svGUI"), I can successfully send
koCmd('alert("Hello from R!");')
but
koCmd ('sv.socket.serverWrite("Hello from OpenKomodo");')
gives the same error as library (svUnit).


more info:

I'm running R
platform       x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
arch           x86_64
os             linux-gnu
system         x86_64, linux-gnu
status
major          2
minor          11.1
year           2010
month          05
day            31
svn rev        52157
language       R
version.string R version 2.11.1 (2010-05-31)

on Ubuntu 9.10
$ uname -a
Linux fs-desktop 2.6.31-22-generic #61-Ubuntu SMP Wed Jul 28 02:02:56 UTC 2010 
x86_64 GNU/Linux

Thanks a lot for your kind help!

Claudia

messages.body_plain:
Hello Claudia,

It looks like you may have a zombie Komodo process. In this case, when 
you start Komodo again it cannot create the server on port 7052 because 
it is already used, but you see it in netstat (in fact, you see the 
zombie there).

There could be perhaps other explanations, but I would test that one 
first. However, that could occur once, but not systematically... 
although, I don't trust completely the complex starting procedure of 
Komodo, especially on Linux or Mac OS X.

This also explains that you can use most features of Sciviews-K/R from 
within Komodo, which uses the R socket server that runs apparently OK on 
your machine. However, svUnit uses Komodo's server which is the problem 
here.

Best,

Philippe Grosjean
